scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Bullet bags will help you carry bullets much more easily.
Come take a look~
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
彈藥桶能讓您更輕鬆地攜帶子彈。
快來看看吧~

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
You've chosen ^FF0000{0}^000000.
You need 500 ^3131FF{1}^000000 to make 1 ^3131FF{2}^000000 item, and it will cost ^3131FF500^000000 zeny.
How many do you want to exchange?

[Kenny]
Hey~ You need the exact amount of items to exchange. Go get some more.
You must have 500 or more of ^FF0000{0}^000000, ok? Also, make sure not to ^FF0000wear^000000 them if you want to exchange.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
嘿~兌換材料不夠，先去補齊。
至少需要500個^FF0000{0}^000000，而且兌換時別^FF0000裝備^000000在身上。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Okay.
If you need anything
please come back.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
好的。
如果您還需要什麼，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
Hey~ You need the exact amount of Zeny to exchange. Go get some more.
You must have ^FF0000500^000000, ok?
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
嘿~錢還沒帶夠，兌換需要^FF0000500^000000 Zeny，請先準備好。

scripts.text:
[Kenny]
All done.
The bag is useless when the weight of inventory gets over 70%. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[肯尼]
做好了。
負重超過70%時，不能使用彈藥桶，記住哦。
